description: Free. Opens a prepaid budget so this agent can call Diamond's paid tools without paying per call. Returns a budget token (pass) and the exact payment: USDC, EURC, DAI, cbBTC, WETH or VIRTUAL on Base (a plain transfer any agent wallet can make), or a Lightning invoice. If the agent has no wallet, show pay_url to the user. Then call any paid tool with pass = the token; each call deducts its own price.

pass.description: Optional. An existing budget token to top up.

pay_with.description: How the budget will be paid (default usdc). Volatile tokens are quoted at the live price.

name: diamond_budget
title: Fund a Diamond budget (pay once)
